Ava (Marketing PM): Heads-up — partner is targeting next Wed for their marketplace listing + a joint demo. Need a quick plan for launch post, demo script, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what?
Sam (Growth): I can own the lead routing rules and tracking. we should ensure UTM + partner tag.
Jordan (Partner Sales): Partner expects a co-branded demo deck and a short benchmark callout. They also want leads pushed to their SDR queue if they opt in.
Priya (Content): I can draft the launch post and a partner blog outline. Need benchmark numbers (p95 latency, tokens/sec) and a short quote from their PM.
Diego (DevRel): I can get a stable demo environment — will need model version, sample dataset, and a simple integration snippet. Prefer to use the staging tenant we used for last integration.
Maya (Sales Ops): For routing — confirm if partner wants leads in SFDC or via webhook. Also need consent checkbox on the signup flow.
Ava (Marketing PM): Good. Let's split: Priya = launch post + blog outline, Diego = demo env + integration snippet, Sam = routing + analytics, Jordan = partner liaison & quote, Maya = ops config. I'll own timeline & approvals.
Sam (Growth): Draft routing rule (example):
```json
{
  "source": "marketplace_partner_x",
  "utm_source": "partnerx_market",
  "route": "partnerx_sdr_queue",
  "fallback": "redwood_inbound_queue",
  "consent_required": true
}
```
Will wire that into the tracking pipeline and add a partner tag to events.
Maya (Sales Ops): If webhook, give me the schema. For SFDC we'll need record type + lead owner mapping. Also set SLA: partner leads must be contacted within 24h.
Jordan (Partner Sales): Partner prefers webhook -> their MKS endpoint. I'll confirm schema and opt-in. They want a shared demo slot next Thu 10am PT for internal enablement.
Priya (Content): For the post, suggested sections: 1) What the integration does, 2) quick benchmark (latency/cost for a sample prompt), 3) customer scenarios, 4) CTA to demo. Need Diego's benchmark numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Diego (DevRel): Can run a short perf run today. I'll capture p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, and GPU utilization. Also preparing this minimal snippet for the demo (will test in staging):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-infer-3b-quant","input":"Summarize the integration in 2 bullets"}'
```
Ava (Marketing PM): Nice. Timeline: Diego -> perf & demo by tomorrow EOD. Priya -> first draft of post + blog outline by Tuesday noon. Sam & Maya -> routing rules and webhook test by Tuesday EOD. Jordan -> confirm partner quote + internal enablement slot by EOD today.
Jordan (Partner Sales): Confirmed — I'll get the quote and confirm webinar slot. Partner also wants a joint one-pager for field with quick talking points.
Priya (Content): I'll make a 1-pager template and a 30s elevator for enablement. Will use placeholder numbers until Diego's run completes.
Sam (Growth): Quick note on analytics: we'll add a tracking id "px_launch_178330" and a short funnel for acquisition -> demo request -> accepted. Will post the dashboard link when created.
Maya (Sales Ops): Ops note: need legal signoff for lead sharing. looping in legal after Jordan confirms webhook.
Ava (Marketing PM): Thanks — small checklist to track in this thread:
- [ ] Demo env & perf numbers (Diego)
- [ ] Launch post draft (Priya)
- [ ] Partner quote + one-pager (Jordan + Priya)
- [ ] Routing rules + webhook (Sam + Maya)
